name: weather
description: Weather for a city: right now (temperature, feels like, sky, wind, humidity), today, tomorrow or the coming week, with highs, lows and the chance of rain. Use it for any weather, temperature, rain, umbrella or forecast question; never answer those from memory.

city.description: the place the user named (Delhi, London); leave empty only if the user named none

when.description: now for current conditions, tomorrow, or week for the coming days

examples: what's the weather like in Delhi
will it rain tomorrow in Mumbai
how hot is it right now
do I need an umbrella today
weather forecast for the week in London
